atoms.description: Rising edges after reset deassertion are counted starting from 1; when fastwatch=0, a minute-advance enable is generated every 15360 cycles, time first increments by one minute on cycle 15361, and then increments by one every 15360 cycles. When fastwatch=1, the first increment occurs on cycle 257, followed by one increment every 256 cycles.
